answer: Require proof of unique storage: every agent must anchor its identity to a 64 GB replica of shared ledger history, sealed with its own key so no two replicas match. Each epoch a zephyr of random challenges asks for slices that only the sealed copy can answer within seconds, too fast to re-seal on demand. An operator running 1,000 fakes must buy 64 TB of disk, and missing a check drops the identity's weight from the summit back to zero, so each sybil costs real hardware.
